llms.body:
# The National Archives

> The National Archives is the official archive and publisher for the UK Government, and for England and Wales. It is the guardian of over 1,000 years of national documents. The website provides access to research guidance, collection stories, visitor information, education resources, and professional guidance.

## Research and records

- [Help with your research](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/help-with-your-research/): Start researching, find records, and get help using the catalogue.
- [Discovery catalogue](https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/): Search The National Archives' collection catalogue.
- [Research guides](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/help-with-your-research/research-guides-keywords/): Browse subject guides to records and collections.
- [Discovery help](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/help-with-your-research/discovery-help/): Guidance on searching and using Discovery.

## Explore the collection

- [Explore the collection](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/explore-the-collection/): Discover stories and highlights from the records.
- [Explore by topic](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/explore-the-collection/explore-by-topic/): Browse collection highlights by subject.
- [Explore by time period](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/explore-the-collection/explore-by-time-period/): Browse collection highlights by historical period.
- [Stories from the collection](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/explore-the-collection/stories/): Read articles about people, events, and records.
- [The Collection Blog](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/explore-the-collection/the-collection-blog/): Read about the collection, archival work, and research.
- [On the Record podcast](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/explore-the-collection/on-the-record-podcast/): Hear stories uncovered in the records.

## Visit and education

- [Plan your visit](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/visit/): Information about visiting The National Archives in Kew.
- [Book to view original documents](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/visit/researching-here/booking-a-visit-to-view-documents/): Find out how to book a reading-room visit.
- [Education](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/education/): Teaching resources and education programmes.
- [Teaching resources](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/education/teaching-resources/): Classroom resources based on original records.
- [Education sessions](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/education/education-sessions/): Online and in-person sessions for schools.

## Professional guidance

- [Information management](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/information-management/): Guidance for managing information and records.
- [Manage your information](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/information-management/manage-information/): Advice and guidance on information and records management.
- [Re-using public sector information](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/information-management/re-using-public-sector-information/): Information about re-use, licensing, and copyright.
- [Professional guidance and services](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/professional-guidance-and-services/): Advice on information management, archives, and collections care.
- [Archive sector](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/professional-guidance-and-services/archive-sector/): Guidance and services for the archive sector.
- [Research and academic collaboration](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/professional-guidance-and-services/our-research-and-academic-collaboration/): Information about research collaboration.

## About

- [About us](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/about-us/): Learn about The National Archives and its work.

The National Archives

Explore 1,000 years of history

Help with your research Search the catalogue Plan your visit

Exhibition

Revolution 250: America's Independence Story 1763–1783

FINAL WEEKS - closing Sunday 29 November. To mark the 250th anniversary of The US Declaration of Independence, our powerful new free exhibition charts the emergence of the United States of America.

News

Latest release of files from MI5

Today, we have made available a selection of previously top secret files from MI5. The files in this release cover a range of events and individuals dating from 1933 to 1975.

Collection blog

A file release from MI5

Over 100 Security Service (MI5) files have been released at The National Archives covering a wide range of subjects and individuals.

Talk

In conversation with Amy Jeffs – Arthur

Join historian Amy Jeffs as she breathes new life into the legend of King Arthur.

Booking a visit to view original documents

Find out how you can book in advance to view original documents in our reading rooms.

Explore the collection

Choose a topic or time period and start exploring some of our most important and unusual records.

On the Record Podcast

The National Archives presents On the Record, a podcast that unearths the real life stories found in our vast collections.

Our research & academic collaboration

Learn about our work as an Independent Research Organisation.

Archives sector

Get help to develop your collections and archives services.

Education

View award-winning resources for students and teachers.

Information management

Access best practice in records management and transfer, and information re-use.
